name: Item Notifier
displayDescription: Buying this will grant you a tool in-game that can toggle this game pass. When the tool is enabled, it will notify you in game about which item spawns and will hint the LOCATION of where it spawned.

name: 2x Inventory
displayDescription: Purchase this gamepass to gain the ability that allows you to hold 2x more items than a normal player can

name: Voice Lines
displayDescription: Grants you the ability to make sounds in-game. These sounds consist of voice lines from the anime!

name: Select Pose
displayDescription: Buying this will grant you the ability to choose your pose animation in game with a tool instead of having it randomly select when you press P.

name: 2x Cosmetic Slots
displayDescription: Purchase this gamepass to double the max inventory space for your cosmetics!
